summary.name: MonkeyEatingMango
summary.one_liner: A free AI trip planner that builds a day-by-day itinerary with Google Maps routes, opening-hours checks, cost estimates, food and shopping guides, and a booking checklist, without needing an account.
use_cases: Planning a multi-day city trip with a daily schedule
Estimating the cost of a holiday before booking
Building a family itinerary around children's ages and nap times
Creating a booking checklist for flights, hotels and trains
Finding local food and souvenirs to buy in each city
Exporting a trip plan to Google Sheets, Excel or Word
summary.what_it_does: The site offers an AI trip planner where users tap through eight quick cards to get a complete day-by-day itinerary. Each day is checked against live venue opening hours, and a Google Maps route with walking and transit times is provided for every day. The plan includes a five-part cost estimate covering travel between cities, accommodation, activities, food and local transport. It also gives food and shopping guides per city, festival dates for the user's travel dates, a booking checklist with lead times, and a packing list based on measured weather from 2013 to 2022. Trips can be edited, reordered and exported in PDF, Excel, Word, Google Sheets or Google Docs.
notable: Checks each day against live venue opening hours and rewrites days that fail
Plans built around children's ages, with stroller-friendly stops and a 1–3 PM nap break for toddlers
Festival and event lookup based on travel dates
Free itinerary templates for Google Sheets, Excel and Word
caveats: Downloads need a one-time $0.99 Trip Pass per trip to keep offline
Free planning is described as available 'for now'
The 43% fault rate figure is the site's own study, not independently verified
